description: Concentration windows probed by each LysK assay and censoring arithmetic for a 10-fold potency penalty
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Concentration ranges each assay actually probes, from retrieved methods.
# Plate lysis: 0.1-1000 pmol per 10 uL spot  ->  10 nM - 100 uM local.
# Turbidity  : enzymes assayed at 0.5-1 uM (PMID 25790497).
# Zymogram   : ug of protein in a gel lane, local concentration very high.
# MIC        : 2-fold broth microdilution; top tested concentration not
#              reported in the retrieved text for Becker et al. 2009.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
assays = [
 ("Zymogram\n(renatured in gel, 1 h, water)",        3e-6, 1e-3, "#4C78A8"),
 ("Plate lysis\n(10 uL spot on lawn, overnight)",    1e-8, 1e-4, "#54A24B"),
 ("Turbidity\n(washed cells in buffer, 5-10 min)",   5e-7, 1e-6, "#E45756"),
 ("MIC broth microdilution\n(growing cells, 18-24 h)", 1e-8, 1e-5, "#B279A2"),
]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5, 4.6))
for i,(name, lo, hi, c) in enumerate(assays):
    ax.plot([lo, hi], [i, i], lw=11, color=c, solid_capstyle="butt", alpha=.85)
    ax.text(hi*1.6, i, "%.3g nM - %.3g uM"%(lo*1e9, hi*1e6), va="center", fontsize=8.5)

# Potency marks for the closest quantified homolog, Twort PlyTW (PMID 25790497)
ax.scatter([1e-6], [1], marker="v", s=90, color="black", zorder=5)
ax.text(1e-6, 1.33, "full-length active\nat 10 pmol/spot", ha="center", fontsize=8)
ax.scatter([1e-5], [1], marker="v", s=90, color="dimgray", zorder=5)
ax.text(1e-5, 1.33, "CHAP-only active\nat 100 pmol/spot\n(10x penalty)", ha="center", fontsize=8)

ax.axvspan(1e-5, 1e-4, color="grey", alpha=.10)
ax.text(3e-5, 3.42, "concentrations the\nplate-lysis spot reaches\nbut a broth MIC\nrarely tests", ha="center", fontsize=8, color="dimgray")

ax.set_xscale("log")
ax.set_yticks(range(len(assays)))
ax.set_yticklabels([a[0] for a in assays], fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("Enzyme concentration presented to the cells (M, log scale)")
ax.set_xlim(2e-9, 6e-3)
ax.set_ylim(-0.7, 3.9)
ax.set_title("Each LysK assay probes a different concentration window;\nthe broth MIC is the narrowest and the most stringent endpoint", fontsize=11)
ax.grid(axis="x", alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print("Local concentration of a 10 uL plate-lysis spot:")
for pmol in [1000,100,10,1,0.1]:
    print("  %7.1f pmol / 10 uL  =  %8.3g M"%(pmol, pmol*1e-12/10e-6))
print()
print("Potency penalty for losing the SH3b CBD, measured in the closest homolog PlyTW (PMID 25790497):")
print("  turbidity reduction : 8.6-fold  (0.21 -> 0.024 dOD600/min at 0.5 uM)")
print("  plate lysis         : 10-fold   (10 pmol -> 100 pmol per spot)")
print()
print("Censoring arithmetic: a 2-fold dilution MIC series spanning N steps above the")
print("full-length MIC can only report a value for a variant whose potency penalty is < 2^N.")
for N in range(1,6):
    print("   top = %2dx full-length MIC  ->  resolves penalties up to %2dx  ->  9-10x penalty %s"%(2**N, 2**N, "DETECTED" if 2**N>10 else "censored as 'no activity'"))
